_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-4.6)**_

In the `.env` file you currently have open:

```
GITHUB_PAT=ghp_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
GITHUB_ORG=your-github-org-or-username
```

- **`GITHUB_PAT`** — your Personal Access Token (needs `read:project` and `read:org` scopes)
- **`GITHUB_ORG`** — the GitHub organization or username whose projects you want to connect

Once set, the sync service will pull projects from that org via the GitHub GraphQL API (`GITHUB_GRAPHQL_URL`).
